title: Grateful Dead Live at Wembley Empire Pool on 1972-04-08
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Profesional v9.02 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a scorching Europe ’72 show – standout Dark Star, Playing‑in‑the‑Band and Caution, with crystal‑clear tones and high‑energy performance.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the blistering Jerry Garcia leads (pedal steel on Looks Like Rain, soaring solos in Caution) and the tight interplay with Phil on Playing in the Band. The show is packed with highlight moments – a monster Dark Star, a smoking Caution, and superb renditions of Mr Charlie, Good Lovin' and Black‑Throated Wind. The Miller SBD source delivers phenomenal clarity despite a few missing intros and minor edits.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive 5‑star reviews, consistent praise for both musical performance and soundboard quality; only a single mild criticism.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with phenomenal balance; minor issues noted include missing intro/announcements, occasional edits and faint Keith on some SBD tracks, but overall superb fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets flow with high energy; the first set builds excitement with tight jams, while the second set delivers a seamless Dark Star → Caution sequence and a fiery closing. The band’s banter and interplay keep momentum alive throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for soaring leads, pedal‑steel work on Looks Like Rain, blistering solo in Caution and overall “full‑on” performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for mind‑boggling interplay with Jerry on Playing in the Band.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned as part of the full‑band tour de force; his humor (Olympic Solo comment) noted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano/organ described as a magical ingredient when present, though occasionally faint or missing in the SBD mix.
